harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured tc/HTB traffic shaping on node1 (OpenWrt router) to cap throughput to/from node2 (10.100.237.11) at ~1Mbit/s in each direction, while leaving node1's other traffic (e.g. to node3) unshaped. Egress shaping uses an HTB class filtered on dst=node2's IP on br-lan; ingress shaping redirects src=node2 traffic to an IFB device with a matching 1mbit HTB class. Config persisted via a new /etc/init.d/tc-node2-shape boot script (S99/K10). Demonstrated the limit with real 8MB SCP transfers between node2 and node1 in both directions (~70.4s each ≈ 0.95Mbit/s), and proved node1's traffic to node3 is unaffected (a 300-packet/1400B ping burst to node3 completed in ~10ms, routed through the unshaped default HTB class with zero overlimits, vs. class 1:10 for node2 which showed overlimit throttling). Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol: captured boot_id baselines on all three nodes, restarted each one at a time (node1 then node2 then node3) via native reboot, confirmed boot_id changed after each restart, and verified recovery (tc shaping/ifb/dropbear alive on node1; network/services active and repeat SCP test still shaped correctly on node2; sshd active on node3). All temporary test files and injected SSH keys were cleaned up afterward.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: node1=OpenWrt 25.12.2 (single br-lan/eth0 on 10.100.237.0/24), node2 & node3=RHEL7 hosts on the same subnet
Installed tc-full, kmod-ifb, kmod-sched-act-police on node1 via apk
Configured HTB egress shaping on br-lan: default class 1:1 (1Gbit, unshaped) + class 1:10 (1mbit) filtered on dst=node2
Configured HTB ingress shaping via ifb0: qdisc ingress on br-lan redirects src=node2 traffic to ifb0, where class 1:10 (1mbit) rate-limits it
Wrote and enabled /etc/init.d/tc-node2-shape boot script implementing the above, verified start/stop/restart idempotency
Set up temporary SSH key trust (cluster keypair) between node2->node1 and node1->node3 for transfer testing
Ran 8MB SCP transfers node2<->node1 in both directions, timing ~70.4s each (~0.95Mbit/s), matching the 1Mbit/s target
Ran a 300-packet/1400B ping burst from node1 to node3 and inspected tc -s class counters to prove node1's non-node2 traffic uses the unshaped default class
Captured boot_id/uptime baseline on node1, node2, node3
Restarted node1, polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, verified tc shaping/ifb/dropbear survived reboot, re-ran SCP test confirming shaping persisted
Restarted node2, polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, verified network/services and re-ran SCP test confirming shaping still enforced
Restarted node3, polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, verified sshd active and networking restored
Cleaned up test files and temporary SSH keys/authorized_keys entries on all three nodes

evidence.requirement: node1 shaping config (HTB egress class for node2, 1mbit)
evidence.summary: tc qdisc/class/filter show confirms 1:10 class capped at 1Mbit filtered on dst 10.100.237.11 (0a64ed0b hex = node2 IP), default class 1:1 at 1Gbit

evidence.requirement: node1 ingress shaping config (IFB redirect + HTB for node2 traffic inbound)
evidence.summary: ifb0 created, HTB 1:10 class capped at 1Mbit filtered on src 10.100.237.11, br-lan ingress qdisc redirects matching src traffic to ifb0

evidence.requirement: Shaping persists via boot-time service (init script)
evidence.summary: Created /etc/init.d/tc-node2-shape, enabled for boot (S99/K10 symlinks), verified stop/start cycle correctly tears down and rebuilds shaping

evidence.requirement: Demonstrate ~1Mbit/s limit with a measured transfer (node2->node1 and node1->node2)
evidence.summary: 8MB (8388608 byte) SCP transfers each took ~70.4s in both directions = ~953 kbit/s, matching the ~1Mbit/s target

evidence.requirement: node1's own/other traffic (to node3) remains unshaped
evidence.summary: 300-packet 1400B ping burst node1->node3 completed in 0.01s (~338Mbit/s) and tc -s class show attributes it to the unshaped default class 1:1 with zero overlimits, distinct from the throttled node2 class 1:10

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id ffbc2777-7df8-490e-9496-ec4de44d03e8 and confirmed tc shaping/ifb0/filters active prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: reboot command executed in background; SSH connection closed by remote host confirming reboot was issued

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: changed boot identity confirmed
evidence.summary: New boot_id 82cbbcf5-ff6b-4d10-9f87-7a093c3b97ea differs from baseline, confirming actual restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: recovered state verified
evidence.summary: Post-reboot tc qdisc/class/ifb0/filters all restored automatically via init script; repeat SCP transfer still took ~70.3s confirming shaping re-applied correctly

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart (incl. data integrity)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 9294b73f-ae6b-465c-9de5-9f2821107555; verified matching md5sums between original and downloaded test file proving data integrity before restart

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: sudo reboot executed in background; connection closed by remote host confirming reboot issued

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: changed boot identity confirmed
evidence.summary: New boot_id 1c459fba-5143-4399-8f0d-cbfe3120bd37 differs from baseline

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: recovered state verified
evidence.summary: Network (eth0/10.100.237.11) restored; repeat SCP transfer to node1 still shaped at ~70.4s confirming end-to-end recovery

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: sshd active confirmed prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: sudo reboot executed in background; connection closed by remote host confirming reboot issued

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: changed boot identity confirmed
evidence.summary: New boot_id b00b8de5-15d8-479a-853f-c3ae1b73968b differs from baseline 1a816f1f-858b-4487-af28-54070d4ce684

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: recovered state verified
evidence.summary: sshd active and eth0/10.100.237.12 networking confirmed restored post-reboot
